applicabilityBasis.summary: USDu is marketed as a dollar-referenced stablecoin, but the current terms provide redemption for a pro-rata share of underlying collateral, subject to protocol rules and throttles, and disclaim a guaranteed USD 1 value. Direct minting and redemption are restricted to whitelisted participants. These terms leave the statutory issuer obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of monetary value unresolved; strategy-backed collateral alone does not decide payment-stablecoin applicability.

genius.notes: The pre-sweep issuerEntity and associated issuerDomicile are retained under the strict adjudication rule; they are legacy metadata, not independently reconfirmed legal-issuer findings. Current terms identify Unipay Labs Limited as the Unitas module operator and smart-contract deployer, and its privacy policy identifies BVI company number 2082929. ESMA OTHER names Unipay Labs Limited with LEI 8755001I0N7CML4A3B92, while GLEIF records the same company number and LEI as Unipay Limited Labs, trading as Unitas Labs, in the British Virgin Islands. These sources establish the current operator but do not unambiguously establish that this company replaces Unipay Pte. Ltd. as the legal issuer of this USDu; the OTHER entry does not name USDu. No corporate succession or separate legal token-issuer obligation was verified. Singapore governing law does not establish corporate domicile. Applicability remains unclear because contractual redemption is pro-rata collateral and no peg is guaranteed. No token-specific public PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, or registered foreign-issuer exception was found in the reviewed public sources. Federal issuer rules remain proposed; the SCRC interim procedural rule does not approve this issuer. Accountable publishes reserve data and technical proofs, which do not establish a monthly independent accountant attestation. Public pro-rata collateral redemption is documented, but no fixed 1:1 national-currency redemption policy was established; redemptionPolicyPresent is false under the tracker field definition.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application or registered foreign-issuer exception was located for USDu or the current operator Unipay Labs Limited in the sources checked on 2026-10-07. General proposed rules, the SCRC procedural rule and existing trust/virtual-currency licenses do not constitute such an approval. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no nonpublic application exists.
